blocks.text: BTS’s fifth studio album, “Arirang,” was awarded platinum status by Federation of the Italian Music Industry on Monday, its label Big Hit Music said Tuesday, Nov. 3. This is the first time ever a K-pop album received the certification in the country. The septet has five albums that earned “gold” in Italy: “Love Yourself ‘Answer,’” “Map of the Soul: Persona,” “Map of the Soul: 7,” “Be,” and “Proof.” The fifth LP has spent 32 weeks on the Billboard 200, ranking No. 57 on the chart dated Nov. 7, after debuting atop the main albums chart.
